report.explanation: All current read-only telemetry is healthy: gateway and order traces OK at 71ms, p95 72ms, error_rate 0.001, zero db pool waiters and dependency timeouts, INFO/200 logs. The order deployment (3.0.2, 1464 min old, valid config) cannot by itself establish latency. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause, so hand off for the missing degradation evidence.
missing_evidence: Telemetry showing actual checkout degradation (elevated latency or errors) in the alert window; current traces/metrics/logs show healthy OK/200 with p95 72ms and error_rate 0.001.
Latency or error breakdown for downstream dependencies (inventory, payment, postgresql, redis) to test downstream-latency or redis-timeout causes.
DB pool waiter and dependency timeout time series over a longer window to test db-pool-exhaustion.
Memory retention time series per service to test memory-leak; single snapshot is insufficient.
Configuration change records or error logs indicating bad-configuration.
